teaser: Why we can now connect any data source with any other: nine steps, owners keep control, a person approves every key, sold as cells.
core_idea: Connecting data across organisations reduces to small steps, access, parse, transform, vault, move, key, open, map, output, with each owner keeping control and a person approving every key that crosses.

figures.caption: Any data with any data, in nine steps: access, parse, transform, vault, move, key, open, map, output.
Each owner keeps its data: vaults move, keys move sealed, a person approves every key that crosses.
Connecting datasets as an agentic cell: two, five, fifty, a hundred, each with its own human gates.
